test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FICTION' is coded as 'C70' and 'DUSTILY' is coded as 'A106'. How will 'ENDGAME' be coded in that language?
solution:
The position and positional values of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, FICTION is coded as C70

Sum of positional values of letters in given word:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6380552c6fa9f36a4540f784bcedd7061ff33cd08cc622d5d2c5be0fecdbd9c8.png] 

First letter of word - 3 = First letter of code 

F - 3 = C

76 - 6 = 70 (F = 6, in alphabetical series)

Assigned code to FICTION is C70.

For, DUSTILY is coded as A106.

Sum of positional values of letters in given word:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa61a6a6d63c07d769b0dade1e358cc47dbffd2999608bf1f14526db9f55f367.png] 

First letter of word - 3 = First letter of code.

D - 3 = A

110 - 4 = 106 (D = 4, in alphabetical series)

Assigned code to DUSTILY is A106.

Similarly, ENDGAME will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcfcebfe31cb756580a2b007bdd0ba0883e874cd584dd31ed942a14c81506db7.png] 

First letter of word - 3 = First letter of code.

E - 3 = B

49 - 5 = 44 (E = 5, in alphabetical series)

Code to ENDGAME is B44.

So, ENDGAME will be coded as B44.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 1'.***
